usedFor: Vyte holds bookings, and HubSpot keeps the person through “Create Contact” after “New Event Is Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Event Is Created” in Vyte, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each booking adds the guest to HubSpot, so sales has them before the meeting.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, and “Event Is Updated” would run it again, so use only the new event.
